body: Malaking policy change ito, pero isang malaking fee hike is still one data point—not yet proof of a broader ‘Japan is systematically tightening against foreign residents’ regime. Ang trend test ko: may independent measures ba sa ibang levers na sabay gumagalaw in the same direction, at may measurable behavior change ba after implementation? For now, call this a strong cost-shift signal. Huwag muna gawing full conspiracy corkboard; kulang pa ang pushpins.

claims.text: This fee increase alone is insufficient evidence to establish a broader policy regime trend toward foreign residents.
claims.basis: Trend-gate reasoning: one policy event cannot establish a longitudinal multi-signal regime shift.
